title: redact.redact leaves password=, secret= and api_key= assignment values in text, so they reach the spool comment and the distill call
goal: redact.redact and redact.scan replace the value of a password=, secret=, api_key= (and similar key=value or key: value) assignment, so a kb!: comment or a typed prompt holding one keeps only a placeholder before it is written or sent. Found by the SP-ficl7pxl review (ST-h3y6iym4 leak scope; the exposure predates the sprint).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;t="password=Hunter2! secret=abcd1234efgh api_key=abcd1234efgh5678";o=R.redact(t);o=o[0] if isinstance(o,tuple) else o;print(o);sys.exit(1 if "Hunter2" in o or "abcd1234efgh5678" in o else 0)
